title: 机票酒店整体改期方案
prompt: 我有事没办法周六出发了，帮我把之前预订好的机票和酒店平移到之后的时间
program:
root = Col([intro, tool, caveat])
$deferDays = 7
$pax = 2
$rooms = 1
$section = "dates"
intro = Text("拖动滑块选择新的出发日期，机票往返与酒店入住、退房日期将同步调整。往返间隔保持 4 天，住宿保持 4 晚。", "sm", "muted")
caveat = Text("费用为预估金额，最终金额以航司与酒店确认结果为准。当前仅查看改期方案，不提交订单变更。", "xs", "muted")
tool = TravelModule([summary, controlsRow, slider, resetRow, sectionSwitch, sectionContent], "order", "机票酒店整体改期", "调整出发日期 · 查看费用预估")
summary = Row([dateMetric, feeMetric], 4, "start", "between", true)
dateMetric = Col([Caption("新出发日期"), Text(newDepartureLabel, "md", "ink", "semibold")], 1)
feeMetric = Col([Caption("预计补付合计"), Price(totalExtra)], 1)
controlsRow = Row([paxInput, roomsInput], 2)
paxInput = Input($pax, "机票人数", "number", "1-9")
roomsInput = Input($rooms, "酒店房间数", "number", "1-9")
slider = Slider($deferDays, 1, 30, 1, "延后出发天数", "天")
resetBtn = Button("重置为延后 7 天", @Set($deferDays, 7), "outline", null, "sm", "rotate-ccw")
resetRow = Row([Spacer(), resetBtn], 2)
sectionOptions = [{value: "dates", label: "日期对照"}, {value: "fees", label: "费用明细"}]
sectionSwitch = SegmentedControl($section, sectionOptions, true)
datesSection = Table(["项目", "原日期", "新日期"], dateRows, "四项日期新旧对照")
feeRule = Text("不同出发日期对应不同机票和酒店差价。选择日期后，按出行人数与房间数汇总费用。", "sm", "muted")
feesTable = Col([FieldRow("改期手续费", [Text("¥" + @Format(changeFee, "number", 0), "md", "ink")], paxN + " 人"), FieldRow("机票差价", [Text("¥" + @Format(ticketDiff, "number", 0), "md", "ink")], paxN + " 人 · 往返合计"), FieldRow("酒店差价", [Text("¥" + @Format(hotelDiff, "number", 0), "md", "ink")], roomN + " 间 · 4 晚"), Divider(), FieldRow("预计补付", [Price(totalExtra)])], 2)
feesSection = Col([feeRule, feesTable], 3)
sectionContent = $section == "dates" ? datesSection : feesSection
dateRows = [["去程", oldDepartureLabel, newDepartureLabel], ["返程", oldReturnLabel, newReturnLabel], ["酒店入住", oldCheckinLabel, newCheckinLabel], ["酒店退房", oldCheckoutLabel, newCheckoutLabel]]
defer = @Clamp(@Default($deferDays, 7), 1, 30)
paxN = @Clamp(@Default($pax, 2), 1, 9)
roomN = @Clamp(@Default($rooms, 1), 1, 9)
today = @Today()
weekStart = @StartOf(today, "week")
weekdayIndex = @DaysBetween(weekStart, today)
currentWeekSaturday = @AddDays(weekStart, 5)
originalDeparture = weekdayIndex >= 5 ? @AddDays(currentWeekSaturday, 7) : currentWeekSaturday
originalReturn = @AddDays(originalDeparture, 4)
originalCheckin = originalDeparture
originalCheckout = @AddDays(originalDeparture, 4)
newDeparture = @AddDays(originalDeparture, defer)
newReturn = @AddDays(originalReturn, defer)
newCheckin = @AddDays(originalCheckin, defer)
newCheckout = @AddDays(originalCheckout, defer)
oldDepartureLabel = @FormatDate(originalDeparture, "iso")
oldReturnLabel = @FormatDate(originalReturn, "iso")
oldCheckinLabel = @FormatDate(originalCheckin, "iso")
oldCheckoutLabel = @FormatDate(originalCheckout, "iso")
newDepartureLabel = @FormatDate(newDeparture, "iso")
newReturnLabel = @FormatDate(newReturn, "iso")
newCheckinLabel = @FormatDate(newCheckin, "iso")
newCheckoutLabel = @FormatDate(newCheckout, "iso")
changeFee = paxN * 100
ticketDiff = paxN * ticketUnit
hotelDiff = roomN * hotelUnit * 4
totalExtra = changeFee + ticketDiff + hotelDiff
ticketUnit = defer == 1 ? 580 : defer == 2 ? 340 : defer == 3 ? 400 : defer == 4 ? 560 : defer == 5 ? 570 : defer == 6 ? 450 : defer == 7 ? 550 : defer == 8 ? 290 : defer == 9 ? 300 : defer == 10 ? 350 : defer == 11 ? 530 : defer == 12 ? 150 : defer == 13 ? 490 : defer == 14 ? 290 : defer == 15 ? 90 : defer == 16 ? 100 : defer == 17 ? 140 : defer == 18 ? 250 : defer == 19 ? 520 : defer == 20 ? 60 : defer == 21 ? 580 : defer == 22 ? 160 : defer == 23 ? 400 : defer == 24 ? 220 : defer == 25 ? 440 : defer == 26 ? 270 : defer == 27 ? 150 : defer == 28 ? 550 : defer == 29 ? 230 : 430
hotelUnit = defer == 1 ? 130 : defer == 2 ? 50 : defer == 3 ? 80 : defer == 4 ? 60 : defer == 5 ? 90 : defer == 6 ? 80 : defer == 7 ? 90 : defer == 8 ? 50 : defer == 9 ? 80 : defer == 10 ? 40 : defer == 11 ? 120 : defer == 12 ? 80 : defer == 13 ? 140 : defer == 14 ? 160 : defer == 15 ? 30 : defer == 16 ? 120 : defer == 17 ? 40 : defer == 18 ? 50 : defer == 19 ? 130 : defer == 20 ? 90 : defer == 21 ? 60 : defer == 22 ? 100 : defer == 23 ? 160 : defer == 24 ? 30 : defer == 25 ? 130 : defer == 26 ? 130 : defer == 27 ? 20 : defer == 28 ? 120 : defer == 29 ? 120 : 140
